opening_hook: What if I told you that overnight success is actually a lie?
narration: What if I told you that overnight success is actually a lie? Meet Rohan, a smart college student who always had big dreams but zero routine. He kept delaying his preparation, thinking he could study everything the night before the exam. But one day, he saw his friend crack the toughest exam with zero stress, and it broke his heart. That night, he realized that talent without consistency is just a waste of potential. He started studying just one extra chapter every single day, no matter how tired he was. It was boring, it was hard, and he almost quit. But he remembered his goal. Six months later, he cleared his exam with flying colors. He didn't become a genius overnight. He just showed up every day. So if you are waiting for the perfect moment to start, remember this: your future self is waiting for your today. Start now, start small, and stay consistent.
